symptom: httpResource can reuse SSR TransferState before a strict HttpClient interceptor policy is applied
checkpoint: Compare server transfer-cache state, actual network dispatch and interceptor execution.

symptom: A single failed HTTP transport appeared to trigger an interceptor side effect multiple times with toSignal
checkpoint: Count network transports separately from subscriptions and error-handler invocations.

symptom: A resource wrapping HttpClient reported HttpErrorResponse as a non-Error value
checkpoint: Preserve the original cause and distinguish resource error wrapping from transport failure.

symptom: Fetch-backed HttpClient error did not expose the expected text payload
checkpoint: Compare fetch and XHR backends, response content type and error body shape.

symptom: New SSR applications did not explicitly configure the recommended withFetch HttpClient feature
checkpoint: Inspect generated providers and SSR-specific HttpClient configuration before changing runtime code.

symptom: Teams lacked an automatic migration from HttpClientTestingModule to provideHttpClientTesting
checkpoint: Preserve provider ordering and verify outstanding requests after manual migration.

symptom: A required signal input appeared unavailable when supplied through TestBed inputBinding
checkpoint: Compare inputBinding with componentRef.setInput and capture the exact TestBed lifecycle.

symptom: Zoneless fake-timer behavior differed across Vitest and Jasmine and could prevent whenStable from completing
checkpoint: Identify clock ownership and every scheduler before advancing or awaiting time.

symptom: Injecting ViewContainerRef before getDeferBlocks caused an empty defer-block result
checkpoint: Reproduce with native TestBed and vary injection order.

symptom: TestBed.overrideComponent broke module imports under the Angular unit-test builder
checkpoint: Compare the unit-test builder with the prior runner and minimize component import overrides.

symptom: Unit-test include paths resolved relative to sourceRoot and broke secondary-entry-point tests
checkpoint: Qualify workspace root, project root, sourceRoot and library entry point.

symptom: Library coverage included dependent-library files and coverage.include did not reduce runtime
checkpoint: Inspect transformed include patterns and distinguish instrumentation scope from test discovery.

symptom: A zoneless Vitest project failed compilation when Zone.js remained a transitive dependency
checkpoint: Inspect resolved dependencies and generated test bootstrap before removing Zone.js assumptions.

symptom: The Vite development server emitted inline source maps despite sourceMap being disabled
checkpoint: Separate ng serve output from production build output and resolve effective configuration.

symptom: Multiple esbuild-produced web-component bundles could expose colliding top-level helper names
checkpoint: Test isolated and co-loaded bundles; do not infer collision from minified names alone.

symptom: Angular CLI 19 resolved a Vite version associated with a security advisory
checkpoint: Verify the lockfile-resolved version, advisory applicability and patched Angular release.

symptom: A webpack-dev-server advisory raised local development source-disclosure concerns
checkpoint: Confirm builder, dev-server version, bind address and patched release; do not generalize to production serving.

symptom: Running an optional application-builder migration with a temporary newer CLI installed an incompatible @angular/build major
checkpoint: Record workspace and temporary CLI versions before migration and review package changes before install.
